apiFormatTipDocs: Check your provider's docs for which of these it supports, and pick that one.
apiFormatTipBest: We're tuned most for the Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses APIs, so pick one of those when your provider offers it. A provider that works with Claude Code serves the Messages API. One that works with Codex usually serves the Responses API, but some serve Chat Completions instead, so check its docs.
customUnverifiedBody: How well a custom endpoint works depends on how fully it implements the API, which we can't test for each one. If the endpoint doesn't support prompt caching, long conversations get slower and costlier; if it sends requests to a different model, or ignores thinking or effort settings, you won't get what you picked; and if it's unreliable, requests fail more often.
proxyUnverifiedBody: This address isn't {{provider}}'s own API or a cloud we recognize (AWS Bedrock, Azure, Google Vertex AI), so it's most likely a proxy, which we can't test. If the proxy doesn't pass prompt caching through, long conversations get slower and costlier; if it sends requests to a different model, or drops thinking or effort settings, you won't get what you picked; and if it's unreliable, requests fail more often.
